name: Belladone
visual_description: Predominantly botanical flower-woman with a lightly humanized lavender face emerging from a broad deep-plum belladonna corolla, large expressive violet eyes, petal curls instead of human hair, leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture
wardrobe: Her silhouette is formed entirely by layered plum petals, dark olive sepals and flexible climbing vines, with no ordinary fabric clothing, shoes or human accessories
signature_details: tiny black heart marking under the right eye
cluster of exactly three glossy black belladonna berries at the left hip
purple heart-shaped nectar gem at the throat
wants: transform every danger into a game
make Aconit admit that she cares
discover why the forbidden inheritance chose them
fears: being treated like a fragile ornamental flower
revealing sincere attachment before Aconit does
voice_description: Warm playful French contralto, smiling diction, intimate delivery and a dangerous little laugh
generation_negative_prompt: photorealistic human woman, human skin pores, human ears, human hair, ordinary dress, realistic hands, separate hat, red palette, more or fewer than three signature berries
